# Muneez Ahmed – AI & Growth Consultant in Dubai

> Muneez Ahmed is a Dubai-based AI and growth consultant. He helps businesses in the UAE and worldwide implement AI, automate operations, run on custom CRM and ERP software, and grow with data-driven performance marketing. He is co-founder of Skilleaze (career services) and StrattIQ. Across 50+ client businesses his campaigns average a 6.2x return on ad spend.

Contact: hello@muneezahmed.com · +971 58 638 8362 (phone and WhatsApp) · Dubai, United Arab Emirates
